verses: Teray pass jab munafiq aatay hain to kehtay hain kay hum uss baat kay gawah hain kay be-shak aap Allah kay rasool hain, aur Allah janta hai kay yaqeenan aap uss kay rasool hain. Aur Allah gawahi deta hai kay yeh munafiq qata’an jhootay hain
Unhon ney apni qasmon ko dhaal bana rakha hai pus Allah ki raah say ruk gaye be-shak bura hai woh kaam jo yeh ker rahey hain
Yeh uss sabab say hai kay yeh eman ker phir kafir hogaye pus unn kay dilon per mehar ker di gaee. Abb yeh nahi samajhtay

Jab aap unhen dekh len to unn kay jism aap ko khushnuma maloom hun, yeh jab baaten kerney lagen to aap unn ki baaton per (apna) kaan lagayen, goya kay yeh lakriyan hain deewar kay saharay say lagaee huen, her (sakht) awaz ko apney khilaf samajhtay hain. Yehi haqeeqi dushman hain unn say bacho Allah unhen ghaarat keray kahan say phiray jatay hain
Aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay aao tumharay liye Allah kay rasool istaghfaar keren to apney sir matkatay hain aur aap dekhen gay kay woh takabbur kertay huye ruk jatay hain
Unn kay haq mein aap ka istaghfaar kerna aur na kerna dono barabar hai. Allah Taalaa unhen her gaz na bakhshay ga. Be-shak Allah Taalaa (aisay) nafarman logon ko hidayat nahi deta

Yehi woh hain jo kehtay hain kay jo log rasool Allah kay pass hain unn per kuch kharach na kero yahan tak kay woh udhar udhar ho jayen aur aasman o zamin kay kul khazaney Allah Taalaa ki milkiyat hain lekin yeh munafiq bey samajh hain

Yeh kehtay hain kay agar hum abb lot ker madina jayen gay to izzat wala o haan say zillat walay ko nikal dey ga. Suno! izzat to sirf Allah Taalaa kay liye aur uss kay rasool kay liye aur eman daron kay liye hai lekin yeh munafiq jantay nahi
Aey musalmano! tumharay maal aur tumhari aulad tumhen Allah kay zikar say ghafil na ker den. Aur jo aisa keren woh baray hi ziyan kaar log hain

Aur jo kuch hum ney tumhen dey rakha hai uss mein say (humari raah mein) uss say pehlay kharach kero kay tum mein say kissi ko maut aa jaye to kehney lagay aey meray perwerdigar! mujhay to thori dare ki mohlat kiyon nahi deta? Kay mein sadqa keroon aur nek logon mein say ho jaon
Aur jab kissi ka muqarrara waqt aajata hai phir ussay Allah Taalaa her gaz mohlat nahi deta aur jo kuch tum kertay ho uss say Allah Taalaa bakhoobi ba-khabar hai
